what: Polari's own first native KiCad bench: the uno-light firmware variant (board/custom/variants.py) drawn as a KiCad 10 schematic around a whole Arduino UNO module A1 - D2 -> SW1 -> GND (firmware pull-up, 30 ms debounce), D6 -> R1 220 ohm -> D1 LED -> GND, D6 jumpered to D3 (the polled sense), all three UNO GND contacts; unused module contacts carry deliberate no-connects. uno-light-simulation/ is its separate analog harness (ideal PULSE source in place of the GPIO, SPICE ground, .tran 10u 80m, a saved simulator workbook) so harness-only sources never become physical parts. Two negative controls are sibling projects. A kxc ingest fixture (KICAD_INTERCHANGE_PLAN): everything in it must come out typed or preserved.
authored: econ-core (dausume-DNB20-series), 2026-10-29, by Codex with KiCad 10.0.6 (kicad 10.0.6~ubuntu22.04.1, kicad-symbols / kicad-footprints 10.0.7) and ngspice-43 libngspice (libngspice-kicad 0.1-43); first produced by electronics/kicad/build_uno_light.py (suite, econ working copy) from Polari's schematic_writer + the real firmware sample, then opened, simulated and saved through the KiCad GUI. That script is retired in favour of the kxc-5a export door (POST /api/pcb/export/bench/{bench}); kept in econ ~/collab/kicad-xcmp/from-codex/ as worker-side tooling.
moved_here: 2026-11-03, econ Claude (dev-kxc-uno-light), at pol-core's direction. Changes from the 2026-10-29 project: the analog harness moved from uno-light/simulation/ to the sibling uno-light-simulation/; uno-light.cir's .include made relative (KiCad wrote an absolute econ path); the illustrative LED .lib gained a header saying it is a knob; KiCad's per-user .kicad_prl files and its .history save repository not kept; derived outputs (ERC JSON, SVG/PDF previews, waveforms.pdf) not kept - their results are below and in custom/reference/.
polari_design: polari-design.json (schema 1, revision 0.1): component ids/UUIDs, terminal -> net assignments, D2/PD2, D6/PD6, D3/PD3, the LightState bridge fields (SET_LED down; led_on / toggles / source up), library hashes, readiness and limitations. The placed symbols carry the same PolariId / PolariVariant as properties.

projects.uno-light: The bench. ERC 0 violations (KiCad 10.0.6, --severity-all). KiCad's netlist = reference/kicad10_nets_uno-light.tsv: 30 nets, 38 endpoints.
projects.uno-light-simulation: The analog harness. ERC 0. KiCad's deck = reference/kicad10_spice_uno-light-simulation.cir; libngspice run = reference/kicad10_sim_uno-light-simulation.json (8032 points): 12.807 mA through R1 at 15 ms into a 5 V pulse, anode 2.182 V, for the ILLUSTRATIVE LED model. ngspice.log, waveforms.csv/png are the 2026-10-29 run, kept as recorded.
projects.uno-light-no-sense: NEGATIVE CONTROL: the uno-light bench with ONE edit - the label on A1 pin 18 (D3) renamed LED_CONTROL -> SENSE_DISCONNECTED, i.e. the D6 -> D3 jumper missing. Why: the sense line is the only way the board observes the LED drive; losing it must be caught from the graph. KiCad's ERC reports only isolated_pin_label; Polari's contract check reports D3 missing from /LED_CONTROL. 31 nets.
projects.uno-light-led-reversed: NEGATIVE CONTROL: the harness with ONE edit - D1's placed-instance Sim.Pins 1=K 2=A -> 1=A 2=K (the LED's model terminals reversed). Why: ERC stays at 0 (the drawing is unchanged), so only the simulation can catch it - the branch carries ~5 pA instead of 12.8 mA. Its .cir is KiCad's export of this project, .include made relative.

illustrative_led_model: illustrative-led.lib (polari_demo_led: D IS=1e-20 N=2 RS=2) is a KNOB, not a cited model: no LED MPN is selected and no Vf measured. Same stance as bss-9's net-current collateral (the generic indicator model, labelled, until the kit LED's Vf is measured).
limits: Schematic revision 0.1, not a fabrication release; no PCB. LED MPN/ratings, R1 tolerance/power, switch footprint unverified; LED footprint illustrative. D3 senses the drive line, not LED current. No MCU simulation, flash or hardware test was run for this project.
